modules.module_title: Assist in conducting pre operation checks

pcs.pc_description: abide with the supervisor's time limitations
assist in visual inspection of the body components for cracks and bearing wear
assist in checking the sprocket for worn or cracked teeth
assist in inspecting the boom, bucket and the stick for dents and cracked welds
grease all the pins, bushings and pivots points
inspect all ground engaging tools to ensure stability
assist in checking that oil levels of engine and radiant coolant are as per manufacturer's indicators
assist in checking hydraulic oil levels
assist in checking for leaks in the hydraulic hose and ram
carry out inspections to verify that the horn and worklights are in proper working order
check battery electrolyte level and terminal tightness
visually inspect the different controls, gauges, warning lights, and confirm that all safety and maintenance stickers are present
as needed, double-check and place any essential work signs
clean the footplates and steps to maintain them clean and free of mud, dirt, and grease
assist with the inspection and cleaning of the circle turn gear if necessary
ensure that the air filter dust bowls are clean, and that the gasket and inner filter are in good condition
drain water and sediment from the fuel tank
top up coolant and oil in engine if necessary, as per manufacturer's indicators
check fan belt tension
